analysis: Praziquantel is an anthelmintic medication primarily used to treat infections caused by trematodes (flukes) and cestodes (tapeworms). It is particularly effective against schistosomiasis, which is caused by parasitic flatworms of the genus Schistosoma. The other options listed are treated with different medications: Strongyloidiasis is treated with ivermectin, Trichomoniasis is treated with metronidazole or tinidazole, and Rhinosporidiosis is treated with surgical excision or dapsone.
